name: NEOTH Daily Summary
description: Inactive template. At 21:00 local time it recalls the day's NEOTH activity, asks the configured provider for a concise summary, and queues it through an operator-configured NEOTH channel.

nodes.name: Schedule (21:00 local)
nodes.notes: Runs at 21:00 in the n8n instance timezone after this inactive template is explicitly activated.

nodes.name: Operator Configuration
nodes.notes: Set neothBaseUrl to an address reachable from the n8n runtime, then set the channel and its channel-native recipient. 127.0.0.1 works only when n8n shares NEOTH's host network. Bind an HTTP Header Auth credential containing Authorization: Bearer <NEOTH n8n API token> on every NEOTH HTTP node.

nodes.name: NEOTH Recall (today)
nodes.notes: POST /api/recall accepts query and numeric limit. Select the operator's HTTP Header Auth credential before activation; this template contains no token.

nodes.name: NEOTH Provider Call (summarise)
nodes.notes: POST /api/provider/call receives the recall envelope's data.hits. Incognito prevents this automated prompt from contributing communication-profile evidence.

nodes.name: Send via NEOTH channel

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: $('Operator Configuration').first().json.channel, recipient: $('Operator Configuration').first().json.recipient, text: 'Daily Summary:\n\n' + $json.data.completion }) }}

nodes.notes: POST /api/channel/send requires channel, recipient, and text. The recipient stays an explicit operator setting; the request only queues delivery through NEOTH.
